rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken construction for doing something incorrectly, especially when the action produces a wrong result.

example.jyutping: ngo5 gai3 co3 tiu4 sou3 laa3

rows.note: Use 錯 as the all-purpose spoken choice when an answer, statement, or fact is incorrect.

example.jyutping: nei5 go3 daap3 on3 co3 wo3

rows.note: Use 唔啱 when “wrong” means morally not right or inappropriate rather than factually incorrect.

example.english: Talking to elderly people like that is wrong.
example.traditional: 咁樣對老人家講嘢好唔啱。
example.jyutping: gam2 joeng6 deoi3 lou5 jan4 gaa1 gong2 je5 hou2 m4 ngaam1

rows.note: Use 壞 when something is not working or is out of order.

example.english: Something is wrong with the air conditioner.
